## Gruvbox declaration

The pinned [morhetz/gruvbox README](https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox/blob/5d15b2765f59754d7ac263c88a0f6e3e58124951/README.md#license) explicitly declares MIT/X11. Its license section is preserved verbatim in `gruvbox-license-declaration.md`. That commit has no separate license file or copyright notice; none has been invented here.
